What to tell us

House clearance coverage and quotes

We cover all of Coventry and Warwickshire, including Nuneaton, Bedworth, Rugby, Warwick, Royal Leamington Spa, Kenilworth, Stratford-upon-Avon and Atherstone.

What affects your quote?

We base your quote on the distance to the property, the size of the furniture and how long we expect the clearance to take. Send your postcode, photos of larger items and any access details so we can assess the job.
